title: Non-overlapping Intervals
statement: Given an array of intervals `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, return the minimum number of intervals you need to remove to make the rest of the intervals non-overlapping.
inputFormat:
Line 1: N (number of intervals).
Next N lines: two space-separated integers `start` and `end`.
outputFormat: A single integer denoting the minimum removals.

examples.explanation: Remove [1,3] so the rest are non-overlapping.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
intervals = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
# Greedy: Activity Selection format counting the kept ones, or directly counting removed.
